description: This file defines the 'olla_algorithm' class implementing the Outer-layer Link Adaptation (OLLA) algorithm for adjusting SNR thresholds in wireless communication systems to achieve target BLER. It includes methods for updating SNR offsets based on feedback and maintains internal parameters for the adaptation process.

classes.name: olla_algorithm
classes.description: Class implementing the Outer-layer Link Adaptation (OLLA) algorithm for SNR threshold adjustment in wireless systems.

methods.name: olla_algorithm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the OLLA algorithm with target BLER, SNR increment step, and maximum SNR offset.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the SNR offset based on ACK/CRC feedback, current MCS, and MCS boundaries.

methods.name: offset_db
methods.description: Returns the current SNR offset in decibels.
